mechanism: Voriconazole may inhibit vitamin K-dependent clotting factor synthesis through CYP450 inhibition and potential effects on hepatic metabolism, reducing anticoagulant efficacy in warfarin-treated patients requiring vitamin K supplementation.
action: Monitor INR closely if vitamin K supplementation is given to patients on voriconazole and warfarin; adjust warfarin dosing as needed based on INR values.
